description: This file defines a Flutter widget class called ShareManageScreen, which provides a user interface for managing sharing of credentials. It includes functionalities to load, create, and revoke shares, interacting with backend services via API calls. The widget displays a list of current shares, allows creating new shares, and revoking existing ones.

classes.name: ShareManageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a UI to manage sharing of a specific credential identified by credentialId.

classes.name: _ShareManageScreenState
classes.description: The mutable state for ShareManageScreen, handling loading, creating, and revoking share operations, and UI updates.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches the list of current shares from the backend API and updates the widget state.

methods.name: _createShare
methods.description: Creates a new share via the API, then reloads the updated list of shares.

methods.name: _revoke
methods.description: Revokes (deletes) a specific share identified by its ID and refreshes the list.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and triggers the initial load of shares.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying loading, error, or the share management UI.
